scope: Source and CPU-only review; reviewer did not import MLX, execute GPU work, load model weights or alter services. Device evidence must be independently bound before final acceptance.

checks.name: actual batched draft
checks.detail: Actual [B,1] model forward per draft step and BatchKVCache extraction; draft submissions B*D to D while draft input positions remain B*D. No fake vector-cap API or kernel-count assertion.

checks.name: exact prefix recovery
checks.detail: Target trims executed q minus consumed k after extraction; draft trims D-k or consumes one final token. EOS, truncated budget and depth zero use consumed-prefix rule. Physical stale capacity is excluded by logical offset.

checks.name: defaults and cost identity
checks.detail: Historical serial/exact replay executes its original cache path without added deepcopy. All 24 strategy/profile/policy identities distinct; default profiled and unprofiled identities retained.

checks.name: transactional and cache capability boundaries
checks.detail: Target and draft opt-ins require exact audited dense KVCache; hybrid in either direction rejects. Full snapshots restore on failure/cancel; stable UID/generation and statistics commit only after successful tick. Tests cover reorder, reuse and empty tick.

checks.name: prospective protocol and claim scope
checks.detail: Frozen workload separates development and heldout; heldout unavailable in current execution CLI. Native serial is quality control, not fair batch performance control. Three independent processes and frozen configuration required for future speed conclusion. Product source unchanged.

checks.name: first development evidence and retained failures
checks.detail: Independent raw recomputation: 10 controls, 20 native-token matches, 490 emitted tokens; all 40 next-token argmax and offset checks pass, 0/40 strict 1e-5 next-logit checks pass. accepted=false preserved including original serial/replay controls. All call/token accounting derived from individual model_calls matches public totals. Native output hashes, output counts, timing and next-state diagnostics match private report. 36 frozen run-source files match execution hashes. Initial sandbox Metal abort retained separately from successful 76-test device-enabled run.

checks.name: public export privacy
checks.detail: Public first report contains generated-token hashes/counts rather than IDs/text, no private absolute user paths, no raw prompt text. Raw report retained privately. Current failure array empty; future exception messages still require explicit privacy review.

limits: Static review does not prove runtime acceptance or acceleration.
No superiority over native MLX-LM or oMLX established.
Private prompt hashes do not make the public corpus fully reproducible.
First pretrained development run fails strict next-logit numerical gate; tolerance not relaxed and failure not hidden.
One process and serial native scheduling cannot establish comparative acceleration. No heldout execution occurred.
Evidence applies to first frozen harness/report only; subsequent diagnostic or harness versions require separate verification.

documentation_refresh.review: First development observation reviewed against frozen public report: exact counts, numerical failure range, memory and timing agree; strict gate remains failed and one-process timings explicitly not speed claims. No v2 claims or execution acceptance added. Runtime, harness and measurement source identities unchanged.
